profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at The Vertex Company TTS
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of industry experience in web development and leading scrum teams. I am a self-starter who thrives on being challenged and learning new skills. I have interest in designing modern scalable software in an Agile team environment but can perform effectively on individual assignments as well. I currently hold a Secret Clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Key player on a small team responsible for building cutting edge MIS applications. I develop responsive mobile ready web pages with the use of Bootstrap, AngularJS, and Less css and program a variety of RESTful web services with C#. I am also responsible for architecture, creation, and change management of the databases that are made in support of these new applications being built.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Actively participated in requirements refinement and database architecture in Microsoft SQL and Oracle environments. I established a maintained a database change management process for use throughout the development life cycle and production deployment. Designed and implemented normalized data models in support of a suite of applications. Optimized and increased performance of many legacy SQL queries with statistics, index tuning, and logic refinement. Analyzed and troubleshot many C# RESTful web services for integration with the database.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Maintained and created applications for internal Facilities Management customers. Responsible for requirements gathering and implementation of an application to manage Locksmith key distribution. Created many Facilities Management Crystal Reports with SQL. Used IBM Maximo to analyze location and workorder data as well as to design a workflow that handled service request transition into work orders.
